description: Search persistent memory by keyword and meaning, returning compact episodic snippets, active contradiction-free beliefs, root-cause chains, and verified Python skills. Use for targeted mid-session lookups; call `oxyo_session_pack` instead at session cold start.

full_episodes.description: Return uncompacted full episode text instead of token-budgeted snippets.

k_beliefs.description: Maximum number of active beliefs to return (1..30).

k_episodes.description: Maximum number of matching episodic snippets to return (1..20).

max_episode_chars.description: Character cap per returned episode snippet before head/tail compaction.

query.description: Natural-language or keyword query to match against beliefs, episodes, and skills.

reinforce_ids.description: Optional memory item IDs from prior recalls that proved helpful on the task.

scope.description: Optional project/repo scope filter (automatically includes 'global' rules).

name: oxyo_recall
